evidence_items.claim: HSBC participated in UK FCA/Bank of England Digital Regulatory Reporting (DRR) Pilot Phase 1 and 2 (2018-2019) using ISDA CDM 2.0
evidence_items.excerpt: In 2018 and 2019, the 2 UK regulators collaborated with 7 banks to complete 2 pilots. The banks were Barclays, Credit Suisse, HSBC, Lloyds, Nationwide, NatWest and Santander. ISDA CDM 2.0 was deployed to support testing.
evidence_items.caveats: Pilot from 2018-2019 (5+ years old). Phase 2 concluded that 'an appropriate solution for producing machine-executable regulation has not yet been identified.' No evidence of continued CDM work since.

evidence_items.claim: HSBC has official EMIR REFIT Reporting page documenting delegated reporting approach using DTCC Trade Repository
evidence_items.excerpt: From 18 June 2020, HSBC has been responsible for the reporting of in-scope OTC contracts where clients are trading directly with HSBC. For clients who have been reporting trades to a different Trade Repository, DTCC must transfer all reportable trades.
evidence_items.caveats: Standard EMIR compliance using DTCC. No mention of CDM or DRR on the page - traditional reporting approach.

evidence_items.claim: HSBC leads global uptick in OTC derivatives clearing - 59.6% of €22.2T cleared (Risk.net 2023)
evidence_items.excerpt: HSBC cleared 59.6% of its €22.2 trillion of over-the-counter derivatives, adding €3.29 trillion in cleared notionals compared to the year prior.
evidence_items.caveats: Strong derivatives clearing activity but no CDM mention in technology approach.

evidence_items.claim: HSBC USA adopted Calypso for equity derivatives (traditional platform)
evidence_items.excerpt: HSBC USA has adopted Calypso for equity derivatives, with the bank already using the San Francisco-based technology provider's platform for credit derivatives trading.
evidence_items.caveats: Very dated evidence (2010). Shows traditional platform approach. Calypso is not a CDM platform.

null_results.implication: HSBC not listed as FINOS CDM contributor

net_assessment.rationale: No CDM evidence despite strong derivatives activity. Using traditional DTCC and Calypso infrastructure. Pattern similar to Deutsche Bank.
